programme.title: Stiix and Stones
programme.desc: The Ninja travel to the Village of Stiix to find the thief who stole the scroll of Airjitzu, but the self-serving Ronan isn't keen to sell it cheaply so the Ninja must figure out a way to make money on the docks – and when they fail to make enough cash, the Ninja decide to steal it – but have a run in with Moro and Sowlarcha. The Ninja travel to the Village of Stiix to find the thief who stole the scroll of Airjitzu, but when the self-serving Ronan isn't keen to sell it cheaply, the Ninja must figure out a way to make money on the docks. Meanwhile, reluctant to give up being Samurai X, Nya struggles to embrace being a Water Ninja, and Sensei Wu gives her a riddle to figure out. Back at Stiix, when the Ninja fail to make enough cash working the docks, the Ninja decide to steal it... but have a run in with Moro and Sowlarcha. After Moro gets away with the scroll, the Ninja are left dangling, but Ronan saves them at a price – for a piece of their share in the Tea Farm.

programme.title: Public Enemy Number One
programme.desc: The Ninja must find out as much as they can about Nadakhan before he finds the Realm Crystal to save his crew, but after the Ninja are labeled enemies by the world they used to protect, our heroes find themselves hunted by their old friend, Ronan. With the Destiny's Bounty impounded, the police hire Ronin to track down the fugitive ninja. Misako has been arrested and is confronted by Nadakhan, who reveals he has trapped Wu in the Teapot of Tyrahn. Misako accidentally reveals the location of the Realm Crystal. The ninja discover that Wu was researching djinn when he disappeared and split up to learn more about their potential new foe. Lloyd and Zane head to the Library of Domu. While there, Ronin hacks into Zane's systems and shuts him down, then captures Lloyd. Ronin uses Zane's SOS beacon to lure Kai and Nya into the desert, where they are captured. Later, Cole and Jay are defeated by Ronin as well. Meanwhile, Nadakhan has used his powers to foil the high-tech security guarding the Realm Crystal and steals it. The ninja are hauled off to Kryptarium Prison and Nadakhan is free to gather his lost crew.

programme.title: Enkrypted
programme.desc: The secret, he says, is the venom of a Tiger Widow, a rare creature that lives on only one island. The venom can slow a djinn down. Soto is the only one who knows where the island is and will only tell if the ninja break him out of jail. Meanwhile, Nadakhan has decided to return to his home realm of Djinjago, only to discover it is falling apart. The ninja's destruction of the Cursed Realm is affecting the realms connected to it. Nadakhan uses the Djinn Blade to smash the Teapot, absorbing all the spirits that were trapped there into the sword. Falsely imprisoned, the Ninja are at their lowest point, but find an unlikely friend in an old enemy. Meanwhile, Nadakhan rescues his marooned crew and gains a new perspective, along with a new mysterious plan. With the ninja imprisoned, Nadakhan uses the Realm Crystal to free his old crew. The ninja encounter Captain Soto, the first captain of the Destiny's Bounty, who tells them the story of how he originally trapped Nadakhan in the Teapot. Nadakhan vows revenge on the ninja and NINJAGO. The ninja and Soto escape from jail, only to find out the map to the island is on Nadakhan's ship. Nadakhan discovers that Nya looks just like Delara, his long-lost love.

programme.title: Misfortune Rising
programme.desc: The ninja's search for Nadakhan's ship turns up nothing. Nadakhan's crew is struggling to handle an airship which used to sail only on the oceans. Nadakhan confronts Jay and talks him into making a wish that will win him Nya. Jay wishes that he wasn't born in a junkyard and was rich. The next moment, he receives a letter saying his father has died and he has inherited his estate. Jay rushes home to find his parents in the junkyard and finds out they are fine, but they reveal that he is adopted. Jay discovers that his real father is the actor who played his favorite movie hero. In an effort to trap the ninja, the Sky Pirates start raids all over NINJAGO City. Nadakhan kidnaps Kai, who makes two wishes, both of which go wrong. His third wish is to “make it all go away.” Nadakhan's first mate, Flintlocke, accidentally destroys the Realm Crystal and Cole steals Soto's map. The Destiny's Bounty mysteriously vanishes from the police impound yard.The Ninja are on a collision course to find the map to stop Nadakhan, they first must find him. Meanwhile, Jay makes a wish to change his future, but it could alter his past indefinitely.

programme.title: The Cloud
programme.desc: A storm is brewing over Knighton. Monstrox has taken the form of a cloud, and is raising an army of lightning infused Stone Monsters. His first target is the new Lavalands Amusement Park. Harmony reigns in Knighton as the Knights pursue their civilian lives: Lance has a TV talk show Axl is the singing chef on the show Jestro is the weatherman Clay is teaching at the Knights' Academy Macy, Ava and Merlok 2.0 travel the land in the Fortrex making sure the kingdom's defenses are ready (part of a plan she and Clay have) Aaron and his hover shield is travelling the land setting extreme records. Robin is at his workshop at the Knights' Academy doing an “independent study” – he's working on some top secret project for Merlok 2.0. It all seems excellent! We even see the Knights new vehicles – which have been optimized for civilian life (except for Clay's.) But storm clouds are brewing. Well, one storm cloud is brewing: the Cloud of Monstrox! Yes, the Book of Monsters has reconstituted himself and is now a cloud who needs a man on the ground to enact his new evil plan. He follows his old buddy Jestro as he goes across the realm on the weekends apologizing for being evil. ZAP! With one bolt of his evil magic lighting, the Cloud of Monstrox turns Jestro evil again (only this time a bit, well, too evil.) The evil duo are back together – and bring stone to life for the first time in the form of Gargoyles from the town of GHOULIA. Now they must gather the Forbidden Powers so that the Cloud of Monstrox can destroy the entire kingdom! A battle breaks out in the Lava Lands, where Lance and Alice Squires are reporting from the opening of the Cuthbert Richmond funded Lava Lands Amusement Park, rebuilt from the remains of Jestro's old HQ. Jestro and the Cloud are after something in the remains and as Merlok 2.0 sends out a call for the Knights to help Lance. Can Lance (with an assist from King Halbert in his Mech) hold-off Jestro, the Cloud and their new army of stone fighters?!

programme.title: A Little Rusty
programme.desc: The Cloud of Monstrox and Jestro unlocks a mysterious Forbidden Power. What kind ofhavoc will they unleash? And can Merlok 2.0 and the NEXO KNIGHTS make the new COMBO NEXO Powers work? The Knights finally make it to the Lava Lands – using their various new forms of transport, which are all strictly civilian vechicles – and they must regroup and learn to fight together again to face the new threat of Jestro, the Cloud of Monstrox, and their STONE MONSTERS (in this case, Stone Gargoyles.) But Jestro and his monsters beat back the knights and recover the STAFF OF MONSTROX – which was buried under the ceremonial chamber from Episode 210 (and is now the Lava Puker amusement park ride) – and they get away on Jestro's EVIL MOBILE, which he recovers from the HQ garage. Macy says this is exactly why she's been touring the kingdom preparing everyone for the next attack. The Knights have to get it together because now the entire kingdom is under threat…again. Robin decides he must upgrade the Knights' vehicles and make them more “fight optimized.” Ava and Merlok 2.0 must figure out how to use new NEXO Powers because regular NEXO Powers do make Stone monsters back into stone, but the Cloud simply zaps them to life again. Meanwhile, in the IRON MOUNTAINS, Jestro and the Cloud of Monstrox find the first of the Forbidden Powers: RELENTLESS RUST. They find the ROGUL STATUE holding the power and zap him to life. Now…they can rust those shiny knights to pieces! Ava and Merlok are attempting to use NEXO COMBO POWERS – with hilarious results – as they try to figure out how they might work. When Jestro attacks, he's able to halt the Fortrex by instantly rusting its tracks and wheels! Robin has his hands full trying to clean all the rust from the attack of Relentless Rust. As the Knights attempt to defend against Jestro, the Cloud is zapping statues to life. He hits a statue with a bolt of lightning as Clay is touching it. Something happens…Clay feels odd stiff as if rock is mixing with his body. Finally, Ava and Merlok 2.0 download to the Knights their new thing: a COMBO NEXO COMBO Power. It works! It can smash the animated statues to dust! They use it to defeat Jestro, but he and the Cloud get away with the Forbidden Power of Relentless Rust. Victory … sort of. Clay talks to Merlok 2.0…something has happened to him. What can they do? Merlok 2.0 is very concerned.

programme.title: Thunderstox
programme.desc: Jestro and the Cloud of Monstrox encounters the sculptor. He helps unleash a horde of fierce garden gnomes on Knighton. What will the NEXO KNIGHTS do against this new enemy? Will their new COMBO NEXO Powers do the trick? As Jestro and the Cloud of Monstrox head off on the Evil Mobile to 'store' the Forbidden Power in a secret location, they encounter…THE SCULPTOR. His real name is ROBERTO ARNOLDI. He's a sensitive and odd artist who has been laid off by the king (the King ordered a "smashing" statue of the Queen, and the Sculptor made a statue of the Queen literally smashing monsters. He takes everything very literally.) Jestro instructs him to make a "bad" statue that he can use to attack the knights. The Sculptor sets to work. Meanwhile, the NEXO KNIGHTS are discussing the COMBO NEXO Powers, the Forbidden Powers, and what all this means. Lance, meanwhile, decides that since his talk show career is on hold, he thinks he'll install cameras in the Fortrex and do a Big Brother-like expose show on the Knights (he decides NOT to tell the others.) Merlok 2.0 and the Cloud of Monstrox (each talking to their cohorts) explain the history of the Forbidden Powers: it's a history lesson about the WIZARDS' COUNCIL, the Forbidden Powers, and how they were stopped long ago. This visual montage leads Jestro to…MOUNT THUNDERSTROX. The Cloud of Monstrox shows him the circle of ten Standing Stones where he will insert the Forbidden Powers. "What'll happen after that?” asks Jestro, curious. "Oh, I don't want to spoil the surprise," says the Cloud. They insert the first Forbidden Power, Relentless Rust, and it locks into place on its stone. They go off to battle the Knights and collect the "bad" statue the sculptor is making. But he's made a literally bad statue…it's terrible ... garden gnomes. Like an amateur art student. And…it's not even finished. ("You can't rush bad genius!") The Knights attack with their newly modified vehicles and they succeed in destroying the Evil Mobile. They then try to use a COMBO NEXO Power, but can't…it had to be perfect to work (Ava and Merlok need to work on it.) As Jestro and the Cloud retreat, Merlok again talks to Clay about turning to stone! Merlok calls in Robin…he will need him to build something to help Clay as he becomes more and more impaired.

programme.title: Weekend At Halberts
programme.desc: Party time in Knighton! The mood is down so the King decides to throw a party. In the meantime Jestro attacks the Fortrex, but he is confronted with the new NEXO Power "The Wedgie of Doom". Clay is turned to stone and everyone is gloomy. Especially King Halbert. In order to get everything in a better mood Aaron organizes a celebration. The King wants a reenactment of Clay's heroic rescue of the Queen. He is (as usual) totally unaware of Clay's situation. In order not to disappoint him further, the Knights get a remote control for Clay's Battle suit and is thus able to “perform” as Clay. Lance is happy to exercise his acting abilities and quickly gets into the role of the uptight knight of knights. Ava is working on reinstalling Merlok 2.0 into the Fortrex with Robin. She is also preparing the Fortrex for a visit from the new Knights' Academy novices. It is a fieldtrip with Principal Brickland and Sir Griffiths with the goal of teaching the kids about these new so-called High-tech battle strategies. Not really feeling it for anything modern, it quickly turns into a regular trip back memory lane for Brickland and Sir Griffiths. This out of control excursion is an excellent moment for Jestro who is looking for an opportunity to cheer up the defeated Monstrox. Unfortunately, for Jestro, Ava is able to make Merlok 2.0 functional again, and the Novices are able to fight Jestro and his monsters off using the NEXO Power: Wedgie of Doom. It is a humiliating defeat. Apparently, this is just what the doctor ordered for Monstrox. A good laugh at someone else's expense. His evil mood is back on.

programme.title: PRIDE AND JOY
programme.desc: Pride and Joy focuses on Eric Napoletano who brutally murdered his victims, including his wife Myra. Protected by a mother, who worked for the New York City Police Department, Napoletano eluded the law from New York to Albuquerque, New Mexico before he was finally arrested on March 27, 1991. A New Jersey prosecutor coordinated a multi-jurisdictional investigation and secured two murder convictions and two consecutive life terms in prison for the killer, who is currently in the New Jersey State Prison in Trenton. This episode recounts the cooperative efforts of law enforcement agencies to catch this serial killer and the challenges the Clifton, New Jersey prosecutors faced when seeking to put him away for life.

programme.title: THE REAL JEWELS OF SOUTH AFRICA
programme.desc: Hosts Kolyn Boyd and Lindsey Granger journey to the heart of South Africa, where they reveal that the nation's true brilliance shines not from its famous diamonds, but from the resilience and spirit of its people. The episode begins in Johannesburg, a city forged by gold and hardened by resistance. Kolyn and Lindsey delve into the profound legacy of Nelson Mandela, tracing his transformation from an activist to a revolutionary leader who introduced the mining charter. This segment explores how a history of struggle became a foundation for national strength. The narrative shifts from social history to the literal 'sparkle' of the land with a trip to the Kimberley Big Hole. Here, the team explores the origins of the global diamond rush. They meet Molefi Letsiki, a Diamondtaires and the world's first Black Sightholder—one of only 70 globally—whose success is a testament to a legacy fulfilled. The deep dive continues 1,500 feet underground at the Venetia Mine. This offers a high-stakes, never-before-seen look at modern diamond production, highlighting the industry's critical shift toward community empowerment and sustainability. The episode concludes by examining the 'Future' of the facet. It showcases how South Africa's ancient craft and natural resources are being re-embraced by a new generation of leaders, artists, and entrepreneurs. Through every interview—from museum educators to diamond executives—one message remains clear: while the diamonds may glisten, the people are The Real Jewels Of South Africa.

programme.title: Janani
programme.desc: When children are young, parents care for them and give them all they need to live a good life. The circle of life, however, means that one day, it is the children's turn to care for their parents and give them a happy retired life. In the current moral fabric of society, rarely and not often it works out that way. It didn't happen that way with Savita too, as her children had no time to look after her. So she decided not to settle out and reinvent her life. She embarks on a journey to discover herself and to make her own identity as an individual. Janani tells an inspirational story of a mother who rose against all odds and became successful.

programme.title: Beti Hamari Anmol
programme.desc: In this hugely inspirational success story, Anmol, a small town girl, not only fights the societal obstacles faced by any small town girl in our country but also takes on the social stigma she has had to face for being so short heighted that she has been termed as a “dwarf”. Anmol, with her strong will power and belief in herself, fights the hate she has had to receive from her in-law's. Anmol becomes a doctor with the support of her husband, in the same hospital where her father works as a peon, to win back her dignity as well as bring a lot of pride to her and her in law's family.

programme.title: Laal Banarasi
programme.desc: The story highlights the exploitation happening with the ‘Bunkars' in Banaras, whose craft is appreciated all around the world, but they are paid peanuts by the traders. Amidst this, blooms a love story between the two opposites - Gauri, a bunkar and Garv, a trader. The story is of Gauri who belongs to the bunkar community facing series of incidents which destroys her family and swears to bring about a change in their life and stop the exploitation by directly trading the sarees. This becomes a battle with traders creating hurdles in her life but she is unstoppable.

programme.title: Dharmakshetra
programme.desc: As The Great War Of Mahabharata Is Over, Kurukshetra Lies Barren In Its Great Warriors And King. The Thin Line Between Fair And Unfair, Deceit And Loyalty, Betrayal And Duty, Has Never Been Questioned. Dharmakshetra Resurfaces These Buried Questions And Allows The Legendary Characters Of This Tale An Opportunity To Tell Their Side Of The Story For The Very First Time. In A Post-Apocalyptic Trial, Held In Maharaj Chitragupta'S Court, The Seeming Villains ‘Kauravas' Are Allowed To Accuse The So Called Heroes ‘Pandavas' And Vice Versa, In An Attempt To Justify Their Actions. On A Primary Level, Dharamkshetra Attempts To Ask Some Key Questions About The Nature Of Humanity, While At The Same Time, It Puts Together The Forgotten Pieces Of The Story We Thought We Knew.

programme.title: Dahej Daasi
programme.desc: This story is about a 19yr old girl named Chunari, who dreams of marriage and a happy family. However, she becomes entangled in the chains of deceit, finding herself on the path to becoming a Dahej Dasi, which is a tradition still prevalent in the backward regions of Rajasthan. The show unfolds into a compelling drama of tradition versus rebellion, love versus oppression.

programme.title: Agni Vayu
programme.desc: Agni Vayu Is A Romantic Thriller That Tells The Story Of A Young, Vibrant Dr. Agni And An Ambitious Investment Banker Vayu. As Their Love Blossoms, An Unfortunate Turn Of Events Happens That Throws Them Amid Conspiracy, Misunderstanding, Swindling, And All Sorts Of Paradoxes At Every Turn. They Set Out On A Journey To Unravel The Mystery Surrounding These Events. Can They Both Solve It Together And Will They Disclose Their Feelings To Each Other During The Journey.

programme.title: Maata Ki Mahima
programme.desc: In the divine saga inspired by Bhakt Prahlad, witness the journey of Mahima, a devout disciple of Maata, as she challenges the tyranny of Indrayani, whose sins overflow in a reign of oppression. Sent into the heart of Indrayani's lineage, Mahima embodies the triumph of faith over darkness, destined to end the era of tyranny and usher in an era of righteousness.

programme.title: Ground Report
programme.desc: Two years after the Hathras stampede claimed 121 lives, Lallantop revisits the site to see what has changed. We meet families who lost their loved ones and ask if faith in Bhole Baba still remains intact, as some followers continue to profess unwavering belief while others have discarded his portraits.

programme.title: Ghoom Ghaam
programme.desc: The Lallantop team travels to Bhadohi, India's "Carpet City," to see how hand-knotted carpets are made. We meet the skilled artisans and traders keeping this centuries-old craft alive.

programme.title: Samosa Critics
programme.desc: After stealing the show as Rehman Dakait in Dhurandhar, Akshaye Khanna is back with an even more intense avatar in Mahakali: Shukracharya's War Cry ! The teaser puts him at the center of a brewing battle between Dharma and Adharma .

programme.title: Netanagri
programme.desc: Netanagri | In this episode, we examine the political battle over Vande Mataram and Congress's decision to sing only two stanzas. Is the BJP gaining the narrative advantage, and has Congress walked into its political trap?

programme.title: The Lallantop
programme.desc: In today's Lallantop Show, we break down the "Reservation Hatao Andolan"—its origins, its demands, and the historical context of India's reservation system. We also cover the tragic fire in an Amravati hospital that killed three newborns, and the heavy rainfall in Delhi that disrupted air traffic, diverting 15 flights and cancelling 26 .

programme.title: Duniyadari
programme.desc: The US has threatened Iran with the "greatest financial offensive ever marshalled" as it prepares to roll out new sanctions targeting Iran's trade partners, while Iran has vowed to shut down all oil exports from the Gulf if the "economic war continues." We also cover the UK giving Ukraine classified data for long-range missiles, the US-Canada trade war escalating with 50% tariffs, and NSA Ajit Doval's visit to Beijing for the 25th round of Special Representatives' talks with China.

programme.title: Kharcha Pani
programme.desc: Sugar prices have surged to ₹70 per kg in some cities, rising nearly 40% in three months, prompting the Centre to allow duty-free import of 1 million tonnes of raw sugar until October 31 . Why does India—the world's largest sugar producer—need to import? We break down the reasons: lower production, reduced stocks, rising festive demand and ethanol diversion.

programme.title: Rajdhani
programme.desc: With the 2027 UP elections approaching, a new 'Arakshan Hatao Aandolan' is gaining momentum, led by General Category students demanding merit-based appointments . At the same time, opposition parties are raising the caste census and OBC reservation issue, while BJP is focusing on the Ayodhya fish controversy to shift the narrative.

programme.title: UP Bulletin
programme.desc: After Jantar Mantar, the 'Arakshan Hatao Aandolan' reached Lucknow where UP Deputy CM Brajesh Pathak met the student delegation and assured them of taking their demands to the BJP central leadership . This sparked sharp reactions from Akhilesh Yadav, Chirag Paswan and Chandrashekhar Azad, who called it a conspiracy to end reservations, while IAS officer Durga Shakti Nagpal is back in the news over a contempt case .

programme.title: Sehat
programme.desc: In today's Sehat show, Dr. Manu Shankar explains why monsoon is a dangerous season for diabetic foot care, Dr. Prasad Kasbekar shares the shocking story of a 27-year-old whose piles symptoms turned out to be rectal cancer, and dietician Amrita Mishra reveals the health benefits of berries.

programme.title: The Cinema Show
programme.desc: From Will Smith reportedly joining Allu Arjun in Atlee's sci-fi epic Raka and Ramayana releasing in 1,300 ScreenX and 4DX auditoriums, to the news that Prabhas' Spirit won't shift from its Eid 2027 clash with Salman Khan's SVC63. We also cover Fast Forever starting production, Extraction 3 beginning filming in Australia, and Ekta Kapoor teasing a Naagin cinematic universe.

programme.title: Zero Cricket Knowledge
programme.desc: In this episode of Zero Cricket Knowledge, we break down India's commanding batting performance in the second Test against Sri Lanka, where Dhruv Jurel's century powered the team past 500. But the biggest talking point was the heated confrontation between Yashasvi Jaiswal and Sri Lankan pacer Asitha Fernando—both fined and handed demerit points.

programme.title: Aasan Bhasha Mein
programme.desc: Aasan Bhasha Mein | In this episode, we explain the Supreme Court case involving Pastor Chinthada Anand and the question of SC status after conversion to Christianity. We break down the case, the Constitutional (Scheduled Castes) Order, 1950 and the court's decision.

programme.title: Gurmat Vichar
programme.desc: Katha by Bhai Sahab Pinder Pal Ji on GTC Punjabi Television presents a profound spiritual discourse rooted in the timeless wisdom of Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji. Renowned for his deep knowledge, powerful narration, and simple yet impactful explanations, Bhai Sahab Pinder Pal Ji brings Gurbani to life by connecting its teachings with everyday human experiences. Through soulful storytelling, historical references, and meaningful interpretations of Gurbani, this Katha guides the Sangat towards self-reflection, humility, and spiritual awakening. Each session offers clarity on life's challenges while emphasizing the values of Naam Simran, Seva, truthful living, and unwavering faith in Waheguru.

programme.title: Shabad Amrit
programme.desc: Shabad Amrit is a soulful devotional songs slot dedicated to the divine verses of Gurbani. The segment features a curated selection of sacred Shabads and spiritual hymns that inspire peace, reflection, and inner harmony. Designed to create a serene and uplifting atmosphere, Shabad Amrit offers viewers a moment of calm amidst daily life, connecting them with spirituality through melodious renditions and meaningful lyrics. Rooted in devotion and reverence, the slot serves as a spiritual pause—where music becomes prayer and faith finds its voice.

programme.title: Desi Beatz
programme.desc: From foot-tapping beats to soulful melodies, Desi Beatz showcases a dynamic mix of popular artists, fresh releases, and trending music videos that reflect the pulse of today's Punjabi youth. The show captures the essence of modern Punjab—where tradition meets contemporary sound—making it a perfect blend of rhythm, style, and desi swag. Designed for music lovers of all ages, Desi Beatz turns every moment into a celebration, whether it's party anthems, romantic hits, or viral sensations. Tune in to GTC Punjabi Television and stay connected with what's trending in Punjabi music—loud, lively, and full of desi energy.

programme.title: Surtaaj of Punjab
programme.desc: “Surtaaj of Punjab” is a vibrant Punjabi musical reality show on GTC Punjabi, celebrating the rich cultural heritage of Punjab through its aspiring singers. Hosted by Saira, Anmol Aulakh and Gurjeet Singh, the show features a diverse range of talent competing for the coveted title. Renowned music directors Gurmeet Singh and Jaidev Kumar (Music Director) along with celebrated singer Jyotika Tangri, serve as the esteemed judges, guiding contestants on a musical journey. Each episode is a celebration of talent, emotion, and the magic of Punjabi music.

programme.title: Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha
programme.desc: After the resounding success of the first two seasons, EPIC Channel presents a revamped avatar of its Raja Rasoi series. EPIC Channel's Raja Rasoi series - titled Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha - stands true to its name. While the lore and love of Indian food remains just as passionate, the new season presents a discovery oriented show format that transforms table-top cooking into an exciting food lab. Featuring renowned chef Ranveer Brar, the show will take you to his retreat – an old-world bungalow basking in the laidback vibe of Goa and then along on a ride nostalgia and rediscovery both personal and culinary. Ranveer's passion for culinary art makes him a perfect fit as the host for the latest season of the food series. He has dedicated this experimental streak and passion for food to his mentor – Munir Ahmed, a quaint, ordinary yet passionate food enthusiast from the gullies of Lucknow who greatly influenced Brar while growing up in his hometown.

programme.title: Sharanam
programme.desc: Sharanam takes viewers on a poignant journey to some of the most revered pilgrimage sites in India to and highlights the traditions, practices, rituals and ideals that bring people to these holy places in search of something greater than themselves. Narrated by Bollywood actress Juhi Chawla, Sharanam showcases testimonies of personal incidents that are the bedrock of the belief, and follows the strong thread of faith that not only binds the pilgrims to their Gods, but also the nation with itself.

programme.title: Parikrama
programme.desc: A journey to experience the most revered religious sites of India. A spiritual – travel series which unfolds untold stories and takes its viewers on a devotional journey."

programme.title: Umeed India
programme.desc: If you'd imagine an ace cricketer to host a television show, you can be sure it will be a sports related series. And, Umeed India makes a compelling case. For the first time, versatile cricketer Virender Sehwag will host a television show. Umeed India will showcase groundbreaking stories of diversified, intrepid athletes aiming for glory at Olympics 2020. For the 13-part series, Virender reinstates the fact that Olympic stars never ‘just' appear at the Games. Their stories start in small villages, where they train every day – with one aim in mind – bringing home that Gold. Watch Virender travel to their training bases, chronicling exciting moments in the home environment besides interviewing the athletes' families and coaching staff. The episodes feature inspiring stories of OP Karhana, Suyash Yadav, Avtar Singh and Dutee Chand along with Sakshi Malik, Vinesh Poghat among many other Olympians. Can we find the 2020 medalists for India in 2017?

programme.title: Tyohaar Ki Thaali

programme.title: Regiment Diaries
programme.desc: The Indian Army is an emotion – a living chronicle of events, that we have the luxury to forget because they remember. The army itself is a family of several regiments, each of which has its own history, identity, and glorious traditions. Regiment Diaries is a tale of the Indian Army unlike any told before. Told by the very men who follow the illustrious feats of their predecessors, it tells timeless tales that warm the heart, moisten the eye, and leave you in awe of the bravest children of India.

programme.title: Mercedes-Benz DRIVE PILOT Sensors S-Class
programme.desc: The exact location of a Mercedes equipped with DRIVE PILOT is determined using a high-precision positioning system that is much more powerful than conventional GPS systems. In addition to the anonymised data collected by LiDAR, camera, radar and ultrasound sensors, a digital HD map provides a three-dimensional image of the road and the surroundings with information on road geometry, route characteristics, traffic signs and special traffic events (e.g. accidents or road works). This high-precision map differs from maps for navigation devices by, among other things, its higher accuracy in the centimetre rather than metre range and its detailed junction and route model. The map data is stored in backend data centres and updated constantly. Each vehicle also stores an image of this map information on board, constantly compares it with the backend data and updates the local dataset as required. All of this enables stable and accurate positioning through a representation of the surroundings that is independent of factors such as shadows or dirty sensors.

programme.title: Kia Sportage Exterior Design in Lunar Silver
programme.desc: A number of new technologies optimize the precision and control of the chassis in a wide variety of weather and road conditions. The standard electronic damper control (Electronic Control Suspension, ECS) in the GT-line version increases comfort and safety thanks to the continuous damping control. The system reacts to body movements and steering inputs and changes the damping behavior at lightning speed in order to counteract the vehicle's diving, pitching and rolling movements when cornering. It also adjusts the damping force in the case of obstacles in order to cope with them as comfortably as possible and to reduce the influence of post-vibrations on the wheels. A premiere for the Sportage is the “All-Terrain-Mode”, which will be available for the plug-in hybrid version with all-wheel drive. The system offers intelligent support when driving off-road or on snow by automatically optimizing the vehicle settings depending on the selected mode and thus helping the SUV to achieve maximum traction on muddy, sandy or snowy surfaces.

programme.title: Colour change with the power of thought
programme.sub-title: The BMW iX Flow meets neuro-technology
programme.desc: The Munich-based startup brainboost used the new and improved colour-changing effect in a one-off collaboration with the BMW Group at rad°hub aimed at raising awareness of mental health. With the help of brainboost, the BMW iX Flow was connected directly to the brain of the rad°hub delegates using an electroencephalograph (EEG), which records the brain's electrical activity. “The colour patterns of the BMW iX Flow react to brain activity and reflect the level of activity,” explains brainboost CEO Philipp Heiler. “Once the brain is at rest, the changes of patterns on the iX Flow also become calmer and more rhythmical.” A special animation was activated if delegates managed to maintain this state for several seconds. Thus, the participants were able to gradually calm and relax their brains under the guidance of the brainboost experts and with the help of neurofeedback via the iX Flow. This matures the knowledge of which strategies work best to specifically shut down one's own brain activity for relaxation, e.g. in everyday working life.

The epic ascent saw New Range Rover Sport resist the surging torrent of water flowing down the ramp of the Karahnjukar Dam – the biggest of its kind in the world – at a rate of 750 tonnes per minute. A loss of traction risked plunging down the perilous 90m drop at the base of the spillway to the valley floor below. The successful spillway ascent was screened for the first time at an exclusive launch event at Jaguar Land Rover's Advanced Product Creation Centre at Gaydon, UK. Official James Bond stunt driver Jessica Hawkins was behind the wheel as the New Range Rover Sport demonstrated its grip, traction, performance and composure, completing the latest in a series of challenges for Land Rover's luxury performance SUV. Previous feats include a record-setting hill-climb at Pikes Peak, a first recorded crossing of the ‘Empty Quarter' desert in the Arabian Peninsula and a first ascent of the 999 steps to Heaven's Gate in China, in 2018.

programme.desc: Nel 1994 Edoardo, capitano di lungo corso, torna, dopo mesi di assenza, ad Apricale, paesino ligure arroccato al confine con la Francia. Lo attende Clara con la speranza di una vita in comune. Ma Edoardo non riesce a superare i ricordi di un passato difficile (Clara era fidanzata con il fratello poi morto) con molti sensi di colpa e cerca un nuovo imbarco. Accetta così la proposta, per conto della Legione Straniera, dell'armatore François: portare da Tolone alle coste jugoslave un carico di armi sull'Hondurian Star, un vecchio mercantile. Solo in mare aperto l'equipaggio viene a conoscenza del carico e, dopo molti contrasti, decide di proseguire. Consegnata la merce, Edoardo aspetta di incassare la cifra pattuita, ma l'operazione si dimostra improvvisamente difficile.

programme.title: Alieni in soffitta

programme.title: Space Kids
programme.desc: In un futuro lontano, un pianeta un tempo rigoglioso è diventato un deserto dopo la distruzione della pianta che ne garantiva la sopravvivenza. Tre giovani eroi decidono di sfidare robot, vulcani e pericoli estremi per trovare l'ultima pianta rimasta e salvare il loro mondo.

programme.title: Chestnut
programme.desc: Le giovani sorelle orfane Sal e Rae pensano di aver fatto centro quando trovano un adorabile cucciolo di alano il giorno stesso in cui vengono informate che saranno adottate... ma presto scopriranno che nel loro nuovo elegante appartamento a Manhattan i cani non sono ammessi.

programme.title: L'ape Maia il film
programme.desc: Sullo sfondo di una lotta secolare tra api e vespe, la piccola e anticonformista Maia nasce in un alveare dove non è facile essere diversi.

programme.title: Il merlo maschio
programme.desc: Niccolò Vivaldi è un violoncellista che soffre di un forte complesso d'inferiorità, sia per la scarsa riuscita professionale, sia perché poco stimato e considerato dal prossimo. Quando scopre che sua moglie piace molto agli altri uomini, inizia a farla posare nuda.

programme.title: Action
programme.desc: Bruno Martel è un attore fallito, ridottosi a girare piccoli ruoli in film di serie b, che viene ripetutamente tradito dalla moglie Ann, una fotomodella. L'uomo decide allora di buttarsi nel cinema porno, ma l'ambiente lo disgusta a tal punto da farlo fuggire insieme ad Ofelia, una sua giovane collega di set.

programme.title: Mia moglie, un corpo per l'amore
programme.desc: La storia di una modella ninfomane sposata con un uomo d'affari di qualche anno più grande di lei. Sebbene lui sia a conoscenza delle numerose, numerosissime infedeltà della moglie, per molto tempo non è chiaro se in realtà ne sia geloso o se invece la cosa lo ecciti.

programme.title: Adultero lui, adultera lei
programme.desc: Lina decide a sua volta di tradire il marito con un comune amico, Piero, nella stessa pensione dove lui la tradisce da anni. Il marito di Lina la denuncia, per poi ritirare la querela di fronte ai propositi suicidi della moglie di Piero. Da quest'ultimo, il marito di Lina verrà a sapere che la moglie non l'ha mai tradito. Tra i due torna il sereno. Il lupo, però, perde il pelo ma non il vizio.

programme.title: Il brigadiere Pasquale Zagaria ama la mamma e la polizia
programme.desc: Primo film da protagonista di Lino Banfi. Degradato e infine espulso dalla polizia per inettitudine comprovata, il brigadiere pugliese Pasquale Zagaria si ritira a vita privata nella campagna romana. Ma ben presto resta coinvolto in un oscuro traffico di diamanti. Con l'aiuto della vigorosa moglie Pupetta, cintura nera di karate, Zagaria torna ad affrontare i delinquenti.

programme.title: La bambolona
programme.desc: Un avvocato, interpretato da Ugo Tognazzi, perde la testa per una ragazza che apparentemente sembra ingenua e sprovveduta. In realtà, la giovane donna sfrutta astutamente la sua bellezza per abbindolare il suo maturo spasimante.

programme.title: I Cadetti di Guascogna
programme.desc: Bellissima commedia piena di divertenti equivoci con Walter Chiari e Ugo Tognazzi. Walter e Ugo hanno un debole per la bella Vittoria, ma il padre, che nulla vuole saperne, spedisce la ragazza a Bracciano, dalla zia. Caso vuole, però, che entrambi i pretendenti ricevano una chiamata che li destina proprio sulle rive del lago laziale dove, incontrata la dolce fanciulla, accade una cosa imprevista.

programme.title: I ragazzi dei Parioli
programme.desc: Una storia sui giovani della classe borghese italiana degli anni Sessanta e sui loro modi di impiegare il tempo.

programme.title: Detenuto in attesa di giudizio
programme.desc: Giuseppe è un geometra emigrato in Svezia, dove ha fatto fortuna con la sua piccola impresa edile. Torna in Italia per far conoscere il suo Paese alla moglie Ingrid, ma alla frontiera viene inspiegabilmente fermato e quindi arrestato. In carcere, scopre di essere accusato di un delitto gravissimo. Una delle rare interpretazioni drammatiche del magistrale Alberto Sordi.

programme.title: Ciao maschio
programme.desc: Il rifiuto della paternità e la scelta di adottare come figlio una scimmietta saranno per il protagonista, Lafayette , l'ultima e delirante affermazione di individualità.

programme.title: Piccolo mondo antico
programme.desc: Durante il Risorgimento, un giovane di nobile casato sposa, contro il volere della nonna austricante, una donna borghese e va a vivere sul lago di Como. La loro bambina annega per una svista fatale, e la giovane madre quasi impazzisce. Si riprende solo quando lo sposo, che intanto ha aderito ai movimenti clandestini rivoluzionari, annuncia la sua partenza per la guerra di Crimea.

programme.title: Aida
programme.desc: Il giovane Radames, condottiero delle truppe egiziane e trionfatore sugli Etiopi nella guerra per il possesso dell`alta valle del Nilo, ottiene dal faraone la liberazione della bellissima schiava Aida, di cui è innamorato, e di suo padre, Amonasro, re degli etiopi. Costretta dall`autorità del padre, Aida induce Radames a rivelare il segreto delle future mosse dell`esercito egiziano.

programme.title: I fuorilegge del matrimonio
programme.desc: Sei storie di matrimoni impossibili: tra leggi, ricatti e assurdità burocratiche, uomini e donne si ritrovano intrappolati in legami che non possono sciogliere. Tra manicomio, carcere, divorzio estero e conventi, l'amore si scontra con l'inflessibilità delle istituzioni, generando drammi, equivoci e amara ironia.

programme.title: Matrimonio all'italiana
programme.desc: Dopo essere stata domestica e amante del ricco Domenico, Filumena, fingendosi in punto di morte, riesce a farsi sposare. L`inganno però viene scoperto e Domenico è risoluto a sciogliere il matrimonio, ma Filumena non si arrende e cos gli rivela di avere tre figli, uno dei quali suo...

programme.title: 7 Km Da Gerusalemme
programme.desc: Alessandro, un pubblicitario in crisi, si ritrova a Gerusalemme dove incontra un uomo che sostiene di essere Gesù. Scettico, decide comunque di dialogare con lui.

programme.title: Con amore, Antosha
programme.desc: Grazie a una prolifica carriera cinematografica e televisiva, Anton Yelchin ha lasciato un'eredità indelebile come attore. Attraverso i suoi diari e altri scritti, le sue fotografie, la musica originale che ha scritto e le interviste con la sua famiglia, i suoi amici e i suoi colleghi, questo film non si limita a esaminare l'impressionante carriera di Anton, ma offre un ritratto più ampio dell'uomo.

programme.title: Prima danza e poi pensa

Mentre riaffiora un ricordo d'infanzia che la libera dai tormenti, emerge un'indagine che svela crimini del suo maestro di scacchi, culminati in un tragico epilogo.

programme.title: PER AMORE DI LILY

programme.title: Falsa identità

programme.title: PRIGIONIERA D'AMORE

programme.title: Otzi

Gibson e gli altri poliziotti coinvolti nel caso non sono interessati realmente a cercare di capire chi possa essere l'assassino e così Stanley decide di rivolgersi al vecchio.

programme.desc: I destini di un sicario ormai anziano e di un detective senza futuro si intrecciano quando un ultimo incarico offre l'ultima occasione di risolvere un vecchio conto in sospeso.
